name: Story: the evening shift until the power goes
notes: STORY-ON-FREEFORM-01 step 6, act evening (first draft, Claude 11 Nov night). Started by evening_handover once handover_done. Routine check (N01_ROUTINE, a ui scene), the evening moves on to 22:30, then Freeform's own feeder_fault takes the power (started for the story: FS47FreeformDirector::StartForStory) and the act waits for its repair (story flag power_restored, set by the director when Freeform's power fault ends). Dale's power calls D11/D12 are left out: their text sends the player to a 'junction station down the gravel turnoff', while Freeform's fault is at the road cabinet (ff:feeder); the pack's text needs that place first.
